preparation_contract: Same pre-fold rate seed at every s and M gain; recruited rates from the frozen high branch nearest each s. Synapses and delay history initialized consistently from rates; M starts at its rate-matched equilibrium. This is a finite-preparation map, not exhaustive basin stability.
analysis_contract: Use the existing strict tonic endpoint. Preserve indeterminate and nonstationary cells. Native delays, frozen spatial Z, dynamic M, zero added OU. No recovery or oscillation-depth requirement.
scope: single topology 2542, 10x10 deterministic coarse system; not full-SNN transition probability
